C0677.title: From JS Map Leak to OSS Bucket Takeover: A Classic Case Study
C0677.summary: In May 2024, a security researcher published a penetration-testing case in which leaked frontend js.map files were used to recover Vue source code. Further API analysis revealed access to Alibaba Cloud OSS-related sensitive information. By using a temporary STS token, the researcher took control of multiple object storage buckets, could create, read, update, and delete files, and found server backups, databases, logs, and other sensitive files in the buckets. The case shows how frontend source exposure can escalate into cloud storage takeover.
